description:
At just about 18 lbs, the Lightning is a bike that changes the steel fixed-gear/single-speed game. It's the perfect combination of characteristics—light and fast, but with that great ride of super-light steel.

The latest colors are Summit Blue, a medium solid blue, and Crystal Grey, a dark pearlized grey. We also have some remaining stock of Pearl Black, a dark pearlescent black.

The Lightning also features our Wabi Pro headset, a no-logo version of the FSA Orbit-X, and Wabi Sub-15s as stock parts.

Check here for our latest estimated turnaround time for builds and current inventory status. Timing can vary depending on our order backlog. See the link for more info.

LIGHTWEIGHT PERFORMANCE

For those looking for one of the lightest one-gear rides out there, the Lightning delivers. It features a triple-butted Columbus Spirit frame, a sleek carbon fork, and our lightweight wheelset for a weight of about 18.5 pounds (55cm).

The Lightning features our Wabi hybrid track-road frame geometry - designed to be nimble for quick dashes through the city or comfortable for long rides on the backroads.

ROCK SOLID COMPONENTS

Our builds feature rock-solid components that bring together the quality, performance, and minimalist aesthetic that you expect from Wabi.

Components are curated to ensure light weight, low maintenance and clean lines while not sacrificing performance - or breaking the bank. We source directly from well-regarded brands like Andel, Tektro, FSA and Tange - all in our no-logo approach.

BASE SPECS

Frame: TIG-welded Columbus Spirit triple-butted, heat-treated tubing.

Fork: Carbon fork with 1-1/8" aluminum steerer tube, painted to match frame.

Wheels: Lightweight 700c tubeless-compatible wheels, flip-flop hubs, and 20/24 double-butted spokes in all-black or all-silver.

Gearing: 46T chainring with both 18T freewheel and fixed cog. Freewheel/single speed on the drive side is default.

Brakes: Lightweight, forged aluminum dual-pivot caliper brakes.

Saddle: Synthetic leather in a choice of styles.

Seatpost: 27.2mm alloy post with 24mm setback single-bolt design.

Note that we are substituting a slightly different design for our silver seatpost due to factory delays. If you want the stock seatpost, we can ship it at a later time.

Stem: 26mm clamp with -17 degree rise for that classic horizontal stem look.

Headset: Wabi Pro 1-1/8" threadless sealed-bearing design.

Handlebars: Alloy bars in your choice of 5 styles.

Tires: 700C x 28mm performance road tires.

Avg. Weight (55cm): ~18 pounds (will vary depending on configuration)

For the default stem lengths and handlebar widths by frame size, see the bottom of our geometry page.

BUILT TO ORDER...AND CUSTOMIZE

Every Wabi is assembled to order - from the frame up - so you can customize it the way you want. Pick your component colors, bar types, saddle type, and more during the order process at no extra cost. Want to also change the gear ratio, stem length, or handlebar width? It's free. Just let us know in the 'Build Requests / Instructions' comment box or contact us after purchase.

We also offer lots of high-quality upgrades and accessories - from brands such as Brooks, Sugino, SRAM, Phil Wood, Fizik, and more - at a significant discount to the traditional retail price. Check out our options explained page for more info. Want something else? Contact us, and we can spec it for you.
